subject: Re: Veridian - Activation acceptance & custody notes
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@veridianhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal acceptance - Veridian pilot

Ben / Michael —

Thanks again for walking us through the proposal yesterday. We signed the SOW this morning and have routed billing internally. High level:
- Go-live target: 2027-07-15 (pilot, 3-month evaluation)
- Scope: 500k monthly tokens, embeddings for patient-matching use case, real PHI-flagged test records to be used in staging (will require encryption at rest)
- Point of contact: Samir Patel (engineering) and myself for product/stakeholder alignment

Please confirm next steps and a proposed kickoff window. Also include any prerequisites we should prepare on our side (certs, sample files, IP allowlist).

Best,
Emma Jones
Senior Product Manager, Veridian Health
emma.jones@veridianhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Veridian SOW signed — handoff to CS / Implementation

Michael / Marissa —

Quick update: Veridian signed the SOW this morning (see attached RWD_SOW_v3.pdf and DocuSign link below). High-level details for handoff:
- Deal: RWD-2027-241 (Veridian Health) — pilot to start 2027-07-15
- Commercial: 500k tokens/mo, embeddings, 3-month pilot, post-pilot evaluation for Dedicated capacity
- Technical scope: embeddings index + online generation for triage assistant; they will supply de-identified test data first, then PHI-flagged records under our private deployment controls.
- Security: they requested SOC2 evidence and a completed security questionnaire (I’ve filled parts; attached veridian_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx).
- Known risks: SFTP ingestion not provisioned; their network team requires a single IP allowlist. No KMS/HSM exchange yet — they want to use our KMS integration.

Asking CS to take primary ownership of implementation planning and kickoff scheduling. Marissa — can you own the activation? Tessa — can you lead the implementation sprint (integration + acceptance)? Karthik — please slot in for security/compliance validation and run the preflight checklist.

Next steps I expect from CS:
1) Internal readiness call by 2027-05-01 to review the acceptance checklist and assign tasks
2) Kickoff with Veridian by 2027-07-01 (two weeks before go-live)
3) Confirm data transfer method (SFTP / API) and provide IP allowlist and certs doc to customer

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/recipient/12345abcdef
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/45123/VER-241
Attachments: RWD_SOW_v3.pdf, veridian_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Veridian SOW signed — handoff to CS / Implementation

Appreciate the crisp summary, Ben. Marissa — assigning ownership to you for post-sale activation. A few internal notes for the team to bake into the kickoff plan:
- Acceptance criteria (short): 1) Embeddings index created and validated on sample set; 2) Latency under 300ms p95 for generation on staging; 3) Successful secure ingestion of 1000 records via agreed method; 4) Signed runbook for PHI handling and KMS setup.
- Billing/seat nuance: The pilot will be billed at list rates; procurement asked for a one-time po number which Ben has — finance to confirm invoice timing.
- Compliance: Karthik, please verify which SOC2 artifacts they need and whether the attestation requires a redacted copy only or full appendix.
- Escalation path: If we hit any security gating issue, escalate to me and loop in Legal (cc: legal@redwood.ai).

I attached a lightweight acceptance_checklist.csv for CS to adopt and adapt. Marissa, please propose internal owners and a 30/60/90 activation checklist by EOD Monday (2027-04-19). Also propose three kickoff slots in the first week of July (7/1, 7/6, 7/8) and confirm Tessa’s availability.

-Michael
Michael Grant
Director, North America Commercial
michael.grant@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Veridian SOW signed — handoff to CS / Implementation

Thanks — taking this on. Initial plan and asks below.

High-level owners (proposed):
- Activation Lead: Marissa Cole (CS Manager) — overall success, stakeholder updates
- Implementation Lead: Tessa Morgan (Implementation PM) — sprints, tech tasks, runbook
- Compliance / Security: Karthik Iyer — SOC2 artifacts, KMS/HSM, encryption verification
- Customer Success Engineer: assigned during sprint planning (TBD)

Deliverables I’ll produce by EOD Mon 2027-04-19:
- 30/60/90 activation checklist (mapped to SOW acceptance criteria)
- Proposed kickoff windows: 2027-07-01 10:00-11:00 PT, 2027-07-06 13:00-14:00 PT, 2027-07-08 09:00-10:00 PT
- Pre-kickoff prerequisites for Veridian: list of sample files, schema for embeddings, IP allowlist template, expected cert format (PEM), contact for engineering (Samir)

Immediate asks for Ben / Michael: please confirm who will own the PO follow-up and whether finance needs any additional paperwork before the kickoff. Ben — can you share the procurement contact?

I’ll start a shared drive folder and invite Veridian this afternoon.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Veridian SOW signed — handoff to CS / Implementation

I’m available for the proposed windows and will draft a sprint-level timeline next (estimated 6 sprints of 2 weeks for pilot readiness, shorter for integration). Early risk items to track:
- IP allowlist timing is often the critical path — recommend we request allowlist + certs within 7 business days of kickoff confirmation.
- Data obfuscation for PHI: confirm whether Veridian will do de-identification or if we run a pre-processing job (adds a week).
- Staging performance: we should schedule a full load test 72 hours ahead of go-live to validate token throughput.

I’ll upload a simple risk matrix into the shared folder and tag owners. Karthik — flag anything security-specific you want included.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Implementation Program Manager, Redwood Inference
Tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
